question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.

prediction.sql:
WITH june AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06%'
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date,
         CAST(julianday(insert_date) AS INTEGER) -
         CAST(julianday(LAG(insert_date) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date)) AS INTEGER) AS gap
  FROM june
),
grp AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date,
         SUM(CASE WHEN gap = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) AS grp
  FROM gaps
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, grp, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
maxlen AS (
  SELECT MAX(len) AS m FROM streaks
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.country_code_2
FROM streaks s, maxlen
WHERE s.len = maxlen.m
ORDER BY s.country_code_2

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH june AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, insert_date
  FROM cities
  WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06%'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date,
         CASE WHEN julianday(insert_date) - LAG(insert_date) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date) = 1
              THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS grp
  FROM june
),
groups AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, insert_date, grp,
         SUM(grp) OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY insert_date
                        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS grp_id
  FROM flagged
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT country_code_2, grp_id, COUNT(*) AS streak
  FROM groups
  GROUP BY country_code_2, grp_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2
FROM streaks
WHERE streak = (SELECT MAX(streak) FROM streaks)
ORDER BY country_code_2
